scope: Independent numerical audit of the guarded coherence budget and strict floor boundaries on three captured traces. No PVS run, exact-real data instantiation, binary64 error enclosure, physical calibration or C20 statement.

mathematical_boundaries.always: A=(N-2)*Lmax*B>=0 and a valid geometry certificate imply acos(C)<=A.
mathematical_boundaries.principal_guard: If A<=pi, C>=cos(A). If A>pi, this cosine floor is not justified by the budget.
mathematical_boundaries.strict_floor: floor<cos(A), together with A<=pi, implies C>floor. Equality floor=cos(A) only yields non-strict C>=floor.
mathematical_boundaries.A_zero: At A=0, C=1. Floor1 fails the strict combined certificate; every floor<1 is guaranteed.
mathematical_boundaries.A_pi_over_two: At A=pi/2 the budget guarantees only C>=0. A<pi/2 is sufficient for a strict-positive-C guarantee from the budget alone; larger A does not imply that the actual C is nonpositive.
mathematical_boundaries.A_pi: At A=pi the floor is -1, the trivial range lower bound. No strict guarantee for floor>=-1 follows.
mathematical_boundaries.A_greater_pi: No nontrivial cosine floor follows. Example: a three-sample trace with endpoint angle pi, C=-1 and bound chosen so A=3*pi/2 contradicts C>=cos(A)=0.
mathematical_boundaries.global_clamped_floor: Always C>=cos(min(pi,A)): acos(C)<=A and acos(C)<=pi imply acos(C)<=min(pi,A). At A>=pi this is only the range bound C>=-1.
mathematical_boundaries.interior_equal_floor_counterexample: The existing normalized four-sample low_walk has step norms h,h,2h, Lmax=h, C=0 and kappa=B=pi/(4h). Its budget A=2*h*B=pi/2 has floor cos(A)=0; geometry certification holds but the strict combined condition C>0 fails. Thus equality of the floor is insufficient at an interior threshold, not only at C=1.
